title.zh: 将高山省 Kayan 市镇的政府所在地从其现址迁至同一市镇 Tadian 村所在地的法案
title.en: An Act Transferring the Seat of Government of the Municipality of Kayan, Mountain Province, from its Present Site to the Site of the Barrio of Tadian in the Same Municipality
title.orig: An Act Transferring the Seat of Government of the Municipality of Kayan, Mountain Province, from its Present Site to the Site of the Barrio of Tadian in the Same Municipality

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1957/ra_2039_1957.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The seat of government of the Municipality of Kayan, Mountain Province, is transferred to the site of the barrio of Tadian in the same municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 23, 1957.
